question.text: Which of the following is NOT an approach to Social Impact Assessment as per Chapter 7.1.2?

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 7.1.2 identifies three approaches: qualitative, quantitative, and monetisation. Marked-to-market portfolio valuation is a financial-market concept (XIX AIF / XV RA) and is not an SIA approach. The Trap: A candidate who skimmed only the SROI section might confuse MTM with monetisation — they are not the same. Cross-Exam Context: MTM tested in XIX-A/B/C/D/E AIF exams for portfolio NAV; completely unrelated to SIA. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Keep the three SIA approaches as a one-line mantra on every engagement cover page: 'Qual reveals, Quant counts, Monetise converts.' It prevents scope creep into financial-market terminology mid-engagement.
